nl.bodyHtml:
Projecten beheer je via /projects. Je kunt projecten aanmaken met types zoals website, SEO, ads of AI-integratie — afhankelijk van wat je samen met TripleZero iT draait.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem of e-mail. Vermeld altijd je domeinnaam en een duidelijke omschrijving van het probleem, zodat we sneller kunnen helpen.

Bekijk ook andere artikelen in de kennisbank voor aanvullende uitleg over hosting, e-mail en beveiliging.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers How do I create a project to (website, SEO, ads, AI). You work in the TripleZero iT client panel, focusing on create, project, website — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to the TripleZero iT client panel
  • Focus of this article: create, project, website
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Start in the TripleZero iT client panel. Before clicking, note the current value for create, project, website.
  2. Sign in to the TripleZero iT client panel.
  3. Open Domains, Products, Invoices or Tickets — whatever fits create.
  4. Perform the action for “How do I create a project to (website, SEO, ads, AI)” (status, order, WHOIS, cancel or ticket facts).
  5. Check confirmation email or panel status for project.
  6. Document what you changed around create, project, website (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for create, project, website matches “How do I create a project to (website, SEO, ads, AI)”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside create project website
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get create, project, website right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if create, project, website touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
